Project Based Learning: 
Project-Based Learning engages students in solving real -world problems through hands -on projects, 
fostering critical thinking, problem-solving, teamwork, and self-management skills. 
Projects are structured with clear problem statements, requiring students to research, design, 
implement, and present solutions, often in teams. Outcomes are showcased at project expos, where 
students present models, prototypes, or software demonstrations to faculty, peers, and industry 
experts. 
Project guidelines and outcomes are documented on the institute website, enabling peer review. 
Templates for project design and evaluation criteria are shared, allowing other institutions to replicate 
PBL approaches.
